components.css: .ds-map{position:relative;width:100%;max-width:480px;aspect-ratio:1}.ds-map-node{position:absolute;top:0;left:27.5%;aspect-ratio:1;width:45%;border:1.5px solid var(--ink,#111827);border-radius:50%;background:var(--ice,#eaf0fb);color:var(--ink,#111827);display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;align-items:center;padding:14px;font-family:Archivo,Arial,sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:background .22s,color .22s;touch-action:manipulation}.ds-map-node svg{width:44px;height:44px;color:var(--blue,#2046c8);margin-bottom:10px}.ds-map-node strong{font-size:23px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:-.03em}.ds-map-node span{font-size:12px;line-height:1.4;max-width:14ch;margin-top:6px}.ds-map-node:hover,.ds-map-node[aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--blue,#2046c8);color:white;border-color:var(--blue,#2046c8)}.ds-map-node:hover svg,.ds-map-node[aria-pressed=true] svg{color:var(--yellow,#f5ff3b)}.ds-map-node:focus-visible{outline:3px solid currentColor;outline-offset:6px}@media(max-width:1100px) and (min-width:701px){.ds-map-node{padding:8px}.ds-map-node strong{font-size:19px}.ds-map-node svg{width:34px;height:34px}.ds-map-node span{font-size:11px}}@media(max-width:700px){.ds-map{max-width:360px}.ds-map-node{padding:10px}.ds-map-node strong{font-size:21px}.ds-map-node svg{width:34px;height:34px;margin-bottom:5px}.ds-map-node span{font-size:11px}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-map-node{transition:none}}

components.name: Work disclosure
components.description: Native details/summary with a plus/minus indicator and muted expanded text.
components.html:
Behind the work

Originally created by tv7. My fork is a place for ongoing improvements to an existing open-source application.

narrative.overview: Saturated fields, heavy Archivo headings, precise outlined geometry, and small yellow points give the portfolio its character. Content remains plain and readable: generous project rows pair abstract diagrams with descriptions and expandable notes.
keyCharacteristics: Cobalt and ice-blue fields with yellow actions and diagram markers.
Heavy, tightly spaced headings beside regular-weight body text.
Flat rectangles, circular controls, and thin dividing lines.
dos: Do keep real content and interactive controls in semantic HTML; use SVG for the decorative technical geometry.
Do retain visible keyboard focus, selected-state semantics, and the reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Don't replace the abstract diagrams with fabricated product screenshots.
Don't add visual metrics or testimonials without real evidence.
